biocs.name: Rare HTTP User-Agent and Server Header Combination
biocs.description: Detection of unusual combination of User-Agent and Server headers in HTTP traffic
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter http_user_agent = 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MSIE 9.0; Windows NT 6.1; Trident/5.0)'
| filter http_server = 'nginx/1.10.3 (Ubuntu)'
| filter http_request_method = 'GET'

xql_queries.name: Detect Rare HTTP Header Combinations
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter http_user_agent = 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MSIE 9.0; Windows NT 6.1; Trident/5.0)'
| filter http_server = 'nginx/1.10.3 (Ubuntu)'
| filter http_request_method = 'GET'
| comp count() as cnt by http_user_agent, http_server
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
